steps.en: Install the native desktop app for your OS
steps.zh: 按系统装上原生桌面应用
steps.code: brew install --cask zed · winget install -e --id ZedIndustries.Zed

steps.en: Open your project folder from the terminal
steps.zh: 在终端里打开项目目录

steps.en: Downloads the matching language server the first time you open a file of that type
steps.zh: 第一次打开某类文件时，自动下载对应的语言服务器

steps.en: Parses files incrementally with Tree-sitter and draws every frame on the GPU
steps.zh: 用 Tree-sitter 增量解析文件，每一帧都交给 GPU 绘制

steps.en: Edit and navigate as in an IDE: go to definition, rename, read diagnostics
steps.zh: 像在 IDE 里一样编辑和跳转：转到定义、重命名、看报错

steps.en: Answers from the language server inline, without blocking your typing
steps.zh: 把语言服务器的结果就地显示出来，不卡你打字

value.en: IDE-grade language features in a native editor that opens instantly and stays smooth on large repos
value.zh: 原生编辑器里就有 IDE 级的语言功能，秒开，大仓库也不卡

sources: https://zed.dev/docs/installation (brew install --cask zed, winget install -e --id ZedIndustries.Zed, curl -f https://zed.dev/install.sh | sh)
https://zed.dev/docs/configuring-languages (Automatic Download: Zed automatically downloads the appropriate language server)
https://github.com/zed-industries/zed README (Rust, GPUI, from the creators of Tree-sitter)
